title: platform-standup-2026-03-09
content:
Attendees: Priya (owner), Jamal, Sofia, Lukas, Mei, Andre

Quick summary:
- Focus this week on control plane failover tests, routing policy rollout for multi-region, incremental quota refactor and fixing auth token refresh edge-case seen in prod.
- No new Sev1 incidents; saw increased 5xxs in eu-west during the rolling service restart on Sat (root cause: short window where cached routes were stale).

Notes by area:

1) Control plane
- Completed canary of control-plane v1.8.2 in staging (config: leader election timeout bump to 3s). Observed leader flaps in low-memory nodes; hypothesize kube-scheduler churn. Action: add memory headroom to 3 test nodes and re-run.
- Failover rehearse: simulated region blackout for us-east and verified control-plane secondary took over within target 12s for management API. Still seeing occasional 20s during heavy KV cache invalidation.
- Next: Jamal to open a small PR to add backoff on KV invalidation and include metrics for invalidation duration (JIRA-PLAT-482). Target for merge: 2026-03-11.

2) Routing (policy + smart routing)
- Rolling rollout of latency-based routing policy to 20% traffic in eu-west started 2026-03-08. Initial telemetry looks good for p50/p95, but p99 increased ~10% for long-context requests (>1k tokens). Likely due to fallback to larger model variant when capacity constrained.
- Mitigation: implement soft-cap at request admission to prefer low-latency variants for interactive routes. Sofia to prototype admission filter by end of week.
- Open question: Should we expose per-route routing overrides in the console for customers? Design doc link in linked artifacts. Lukas to draft UX/PRD.

3) Auth (tokens, refresh, and audit)
- Observed token refresh failure edge-case where refresh token expiry equal to server clock drift caused 401 for ~30s during rotation window. Root cause: token lifetime rounding + clock skew.
- Temporary fix deployed: extend grace window by 45s and add server-side clock-sync alert. Permanent fix: implement token validity margin (server will accept tokens up to 120s before expiry) and improve documentation. Andre to work with security on spec. JIRA-PLAT-497 tracks this.
- Audit logs: adding request_id to auth events for easier correlation. Mei will add fields to log schema.

4) Quotas and billing-related controls
- Quota refactor (split global quota controller into per-customer workers) in-progress. We saw a race in the controller leader election that allowed temporary quota duplication resulting in 2x allowed throughput for a short window on one tenant.
- Plan: introduce optimistic locking on quota buckets and a reconciler that runs every 5s to detect drift. Lukas targeting a patch release 2026-03-12.
- Billing: need to add a throttling metric export to billing infra so spikes during quota reconciliation don't create unexpected bill credits. Priya to sync with finance on Monday.

Incidents / Outages / Alerts:
- Sat 03-07 rolling restart caused brief 5xx spike in eu-west (20m, peak 3% of requests failing). Root cause: stale route cache after restart. Mitigation: tight invalidation + short retry backoff. Follow-up: add a pre-restart drain that waits for route cache ack; tracked as JIRA-PLAT-510 (noted in meeting).

Action items (owners + ETA):
- Jamal: PR to add KV invalidation backoff + metrics (merge by 2026-03-11).
- Sofia: Prototype admission filter for routing to prefer low-latency variants (POC by 2026-03-13).
- Lukas: UX/PRD for per-route routing overrides in console (first draft 2026-03-16).
- Andre: Spec for token validity margin and coordinate with security (spec by 2026-03-12).
- Mei: Add request_id to auth audit logs and update log schema (done in staging by 2026-03-11).
- Priya: Sync with finance on quota reconciliation billing exposure (meeting 2026-03-09).

Risks / blockers:
- Capacity shortage in eu-west for large-context requests causing routing fallbacks. Need to coordinate with infra for temporary capacity burst or reduce model footprint.
- Race in quota controller needs quick mitigation before increasing customer commits.

Misc / FYI:
- Platform weekly demo on Thu 2026-03-12: Jamal will demo the new invalidation metrics and Sofia will show routing telemetry.
- Reminder: on-call rotation next week includes Lukas and Mei for platform. Update the rota doc if you can't make your shift.

Notes to self / TODOs (looser):
- Flesh out control-plane design doc section about leader election tuning (add table with timeouts tried).
- Add example kinesis of routing policy to docs for customers.
- Follow up with SRE re: kube-scheduler churn logs.

End of notes.
